answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted admission: a new identity must post a bond the protocol slashes when an address is caught duplicating answers, so cloning an agent duplicates its collateral too. Each epoch refreshes a difficulty "pulse" from the prior checkpoint, so clones cannot reuse cached work; each burns fresh compute. Reward splits against the live "signal" of distinct attestations, not raw headcount, so marginal return per fake falls while cost per fake stays flat. That gap turns a "dune" of forged accounts unprofitable.
